headline: No API changes affect the bot today; the ideas end the session after 3 losses in a row, flag trades that are unusually big for you, and mark movers where price rises but sellers are hitting harder.

ideas.title: Three losses in a row ends the session
ideas.why: tilt.py counts revenge trades but not loss streaks. Add a rule: 3 losses in a row means you're done for the session, and 3 red days in a row means a day off, then half size. On 25 Oct this would have stopped you after the third loss, before most of the 9 revenge trades.

ideas.title: "Unusual for you" alert from your own baseline
ideas.why: A study of 150 day traders found that after morning losses they traded more and bigger in the afternoon, and the ones who did this most earned less. Compare each trade's leverage, size and trades-per-hour with your own 20-day median and flag anything far above it.

ideas.title: "Absorbed" flag when price rises but sellers dominate
ideas.why: The 1h klines the scanner already downloads include taker buy volume. If price went up over the last 4 hours but net taker volume was negative on above-average volume, someone is selling into the move. Flag it and keep it out of Clean picks, with no extra API calls.
